newsitem.title: USA: Craig 428 MW coal-fired unit in Colo. restarted.
newsitem.headline: Craig 428 MW coal-fired unit in Colo. restarted.

text.p: A 428 megawatt (MW) unit at the Craig power plant in Colorado, which was shut Friday for maintenance, was restarted late Sunday night, a spokesman for Tri-State Generation and Transmission Association said Monday.
"It takes some time to get back to 100 percent, but we are ahead of schedule," he noted. The unit had been expected to restart early Monday.
The coal-fired plant also has a second 428 MW unit and another with a capacity of 408 MW.
In addition to Tri-State, owners of the Craig station are Public Service Co of Colorado, PacifiCorp, the Salt River Project and the Platte River Authority.
